entryText.breadcrumb: path titles joined with " > "; for page entries (no target) the last path element is dropped; empty -> "Afterglow"
entryText.searchText: lowercased join with " " of: title, description (if any), breadcrumb, aliases
entryText.settingEntries: forSettingKeys takes LOCALIZATION TITLE KEYS. With a registry descriptor (descriptorForTitleKey): title = descriptor.title, description = descriptor.preferenceDescription, aliases = [titleKey] + stored aliases + lowercased title + lowercased fallback title (deduplicated). Without one (theme color keys): title = LOC(key) or the key, description = LOC(<key>Desc) when present else none, aliases = [titleKey]. targetTitle = title.

matching.rule: query = search text trimmed of whitespace/newlines and lowercased; empty -> all entries. Otherwise split on whitespace into non-empty tokens; an entry matches when EVERY token is a substring of its searchText (case-insensitive by construction, no fuzzy matching, no ranking).

onSelect.rule: deactivate the search controller; after 0.05 s: pop to the root settings controller (not animated) and reloadData; for each path title take the FIRST row with exactly that title in the current list (root section items first, then the rows of each pushed picker page), fail if missing or if the row has no selectBlock, otherwise call its selectBlock(nil, 0) and continue from the navigation top controller; then, if targetTitle is set, find the first row with that title on the final page and highlight it. Any failure -> alert LOC(Warning) "Warning" / LOC(SearchSettingsOpenFailed) "That setting could not be opened right now." with an "OK" button (pages already pushed stay pushed).
